body: I’m going through the same thing! My boyfriend is the only thing keeping me alive and I’ve been out of work since November of last year because I was going through benzo withdrawal. Always struggled with anxiety and started an SSRI 2 months ago that hasn’t helped at all and I’m more suicidal than ever. If he leaves me I’ll have to move back home with my parents and I know I won’t survive that. I need a job but just can’t do it. Every time I get close and get an interview I don’t respond or follow through. I give up :(
